domains.critical_1_2: Protect daily time for prayer, Scripture reflection, and spiritual accountability. Reduce activities that create spiritual exhaustion without clear fruit.
domains.struggling_3_4: Rebuild a consistent spiritual rhythm. Identify one practice to restore this month and one distraction to reduce.
domains.balancing_5_7: Strengthen consistency and depth. Keep healthy ministry boundaries so activity does not replace spiritual formation.
domains.thriving_8_10: Maintain the rhythm and mentor others without sacrificing your own spiritual health.

domains.critical_1_2: Give family relationships urgent protected time. Reduce avoidable meetings, travel, or commitments that repeatedly displace family responsibilities.
domains.struggling_3_4: Schedule recurring family time and address unresolved communication or role expectations.
domains.balancing_5_7: Improve quality and predictability of family time. Review whether work/ministry is taking more than intended.
domains.thriving_8_10: Preserve strong family habits and include family in major life planning.

domains.critical_1_2: Prioritize medical evaluation when appropriate, sleep, nutrition, movement, and recovery. Reduce nonessential late-night or high-stress commitments.
domains.struggling_3_4: Create a basic health routine with measurable sleep, activity, nutrition, and check-up goals.
domains.balancing_5_7: Increase consistency rather than intensity. Protect recovery days and monitor stress.
domains.thriving_8_10: Maintain current habits and use preventive health checks.

domains.critical_1_2: Stabilize cash flow first: essential expenses, debt obligations, emergency needs, and income plan. Pause nonessential spending and risky commitments.
domains.struggling_3_4: Create a monthly budget, debt plan, savings target, and at least one realistic income-strengthening action.
domains.balancing_5_7: Improve saving rate, resilience, and financial controls. Separate personal, ministry, and organizational funds.
domains.thriving_8_10: Maintain reserves, diversify responsibly, and review long-term protection and investment goals.

domains.critical_1_2: Reduce passive information intake and choose one structured learning path tied to your mission.
domains.struggling_3_4: Set a weekly study block, reading curriculum, and one applied learning project.
domains.balancing_5_7: Focus learning on skills with direct strategic value; document what you learn and apply it.
domains.thriving_8_10: Continue advanced study, writing, teaching, and knowledge transfer.

domains.critical_1_2: Reduce over-centralization. Clarify decisions that only you must make and delegate the rest with accountability.
domains.struggling_3_4: Strengthen delegation, meeting discipline, decision logs, and leadership development.
domains.balancing_5_7: Develop second-line leaders and standard operating systems so results do not depend on one person.
domains.thriving_8_10: Maintain succession, coaching, governance, and leadership pipeline systems.

domains.critical_1_2: Review overload, role confusion, and activities without clear discipline or mission outcomes. Stop or redesign low-fruit commitments.
domains.struggling_3_4: Clarify ministry priorities, discipleship pathway, and measurable outcomes.
domains.balancing_5_7: Balance teaching, equipping, sending, pastoral care, and leadership multiplication.
domains.thriving_8_10: Sustain healthy multiplication and protect theological, pastoral, and safeguarding quality.

domains.critical_1_2: Stabilize governance, records, finance, compliance, roles, and core operations before launching more programs.
domains.struggling_3_4: Prioritize policies, database discipline, KPIs, delegation, and a realistic operating calendar.
domains.balancing_5_7: Improve systems integration, monitoring, documentation, and accountability.
domains.thriving_8_10: Scale carefully using standards, audits, succession, and evidence-based expansion.

domains.critical_1_2: Narrow the number of field commitments. Prioritize communities where needs, partners, resources, and measurable outcomes are clearest.
domains.struggling_3_4: Use assessment, stakeholder mapping, baseline data, and one defined intervention cycle.
domains.balancing_5_7: Strengthen community ownership, feedback, monitoring, and local leadership.
domains.thriving_8_10: Document impact, replicate proven models, and build sustainable local partnerships.

domains.critical_1_2: Avoid spreading effort across too many national-level initiatives. Select one or two policy/development contributions with evidence and institutional fit.
domains.struggling_3_4: Build credible documentation, partnerships, and measurable national relevance.
domains.balancing_5_7: Connect field evidence to policy, networks, and scalable program models.
domains.thriving_8_10: Maintain strategic national engagement backed by evidence, governance, and results.

domains.critical_1_2: Do not pursue international visibility at the expense of local capacity, finances, or core mission. Focus on credible, mission-aligned relationships.
domains.struggling_3_4: Strengthen institutional profile, documentation, compliance, and a small number of relevant international partnerships.
domains.balancing_5_7: Convert relationships into defined learning, technical assistance, grants, or program collaboration.
domains.thriving_8_10: Maintain high-value partnerships and document international outcomes and reciprocity.
